forkSettings.title: Fork Settings
forkSettings.compatibilityRisk: JSON instructions and higher output budgets alter request semantics, tools are repaired rather than removed, store correction applies only to OAuth
forkSettings.cacheRestart: Cache capacity requires restart, switches and retry parameters apply on save
forkSettings.restartNotice: New requests use saved rules, in-flight requests retain their snapshot, plugin settings and cache capacity require restart
forkSettings.zeroCooldown: 0 disables model cooldowns, while account rate limits and quota protection remain active
forkSettings.encryptedHistoryRisk: Cleaning loses hidden context. Visible messages or reasoning summaries are retained; opaque-only items are not removed. Digest memory expires after 30 minutes or on restart.
forkSettings.replayRisk: Replay may incur duplicate charges, stops after meaningful output, and continuation recovery remains limited to once
forkSettings.sdkNotice: Rebuild plugins with the updated SDK to raise capacity, older packages may still limit calls to 256
forkSettings.filterNotice: Narrows only the selected instance's HTTP mount using exact method and path matches, other instances retain their scope
